key_strength: Concrete GCRA formulas, Redis Function code, cardinality and latency assumptions, TTL strategy, and useful hot-key optimization tradeoffs make the local limiter design implementable.
key_weakness: The core distributed semantics are unresolved: independent regional buckets permit substantial unbounded-by-policy overshoot, max(TAT) is not a valid merge for concurrent consumption, and cross-slot tenant/key checks cannot provide the claimed all-or-nothing behavior. The response also incorrectly describes GCRA as enforcing exactly N requests in any minute and ends before specifying failure handling, fallback limits, or recovery.
